GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, scrubbed along from the 600m and Beaten from then on, dropped out, blinkers off again # beaten 600m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was inconvenienced when carried in across heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn , Held Up rounding turn, Held Ground in Straight # battled on fairly

Jumped Ok Went Forward as expected = Lead early Took hold and Took sit Run Of Race 3rd 2 Lengths , following 1st x 1 Lengths then 2 Lengths race run to suit , Ridden Along Soon After Straightening Up Held Ground 1st 2 out 1st 2 home - # had its chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3len 500m Under Pressure Straightened Up 2nd weakened last 300m # speed/average late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After passing the 200m was taken in by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped out ok . Settled Down 3 Wide 8th 6 Lengths @ 700m. Clear Straightening Up Middle Of Track 7th . Just Battled # No Run On
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover from the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers off ) missed kick x 3-4L. Settled Down a long last. 12 Lengths . Same Straightening Up . Just Held Ground # tardy/always last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics to be ridden conservatively; settled back. Rider reported that after the start was affected her mount reared on jumping and lost ground. She said that mount was then slow to muster, resulting in the mare being tailed off throughout the event. Trainer was advised that a warning would be recorded against the mare for rearing at the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Quickly sent forward, Crossed to Lead on rail x 1 length @ 800m. gap to 3rd, these two going too Quickly . Collared on Straightening Up and had nothing left # led too Quickly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start bumped with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok bustled, faced breeze 1 length off, under pressure turn and dropped out # breeze/too quick?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, apprentice stated mount settled outside leader, & she was required to encourage it along in middle stages to hold this position, as a genuine tempo was set. App stated mount was under full pressure passing 600m & weakened to line down the straight. App stated mount was 1st up today, over 1200m, & this combined with the manner in which the race was run all appeared to have taken a toll on the mares finishing effort. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare revealed it to have a slow recovery rate

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear and drew clear in the run to the line # led/no danger
Jumped Well , Crossed Two Wide 3rd, 2 Lengths @ 1000m. Under Pressure Straightening Up fanning 3 Wide Straightening Up . Gradually Gave Ground # didn't finish off
